nameJa: アイボリーのカットペーパー
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: アイボリーと赤、切り紙の輪郭と小さな陰影。大きなタイプと一枚の黒い画面を、余白のある対角構成に。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one beautiful premium editorial promotional image for a Chrome browser extension that puts live chat inside fullscreen YouTube video. Wide 11:7 artwork, target 1760 × 1120, edge-to-edge.
Art direction: sophisticated conceptual cut-paper graphic, warm ivory, rich vermilion red, near-black typography. Precisely cut heavy art paper, lovely restrained real physical layer shadows, sharp clean edges, subtle fine paper fibres. A designer's physical paper maquette photographed straight-on, refined and architectural, not childish craft or toy-like illustration.
Layout: left 43 percent is typography, right 50 percent is one widescreen video symbol. On the left use “YouTube” in substantial medium black sans-serif at the top; below it put “Fullscreen” in very bold carefully condensed black type on ONE unbroken line, and “Live Chat” as one bold red line below. Leave intentional spacious margins. On the right, a crisp black landscape video card with EXACT 16:9 proportions, about 50 percent of the total image width, sits on an ivory paper field. Its 4 small ivory fullscreen corner marks sit just inside the card, an ivory play triangle rests left of center, and a single saturated red cut-paper chat shape with a very short geometric tail is fully INSIDE the right of the video card. The chat shape has three simple ivory short strokes with no labels. Every part of the red chat shape, including tail, is inside the black video card. Paper layers have only subtle depth and grounded shadows, not hovering into the distance.
Visible text verbatim, exactly once each: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. No other words, no tagline, no small captions, no watermark or numbers. All text legible at 220 × 140 preview. 7 percent safe inset for text. No overlaps between diagram and type.
No faces, people, avatars, names, video scenes, gaming artwork, photos of devices, browser toolbars, fake chat text, UI dashboard, rainbows, generic neon glow, floating gradient blobs, decorative doodles or stickers. Restrained high-end physical design and memorable graphic typography.
revisionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose this reference promotional design into an EXACT landscape 11:7 canvas (1760 × 1120). The current image is much too wide: make the new canvas noticeably taller. Preserve the exact ivory / black / vermilion physical cut-paper aesthetic, sophisticated condensed typography and lovely subtle paper shadows. Keep three text groups, each exactly ONCE: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen” (ONE word), “Live Chat”. No other visible words. On this taller canvas place typography in upper/left area and the screen in lower/right area. All letters inset at least 7% from canvas edges, with comfortable breathing room; all three phrases immediately legible at 220 × 140. The black video card must remain a true 16:9 LANDSCAPE rectangle with four ivory fullscreen corner marks, one ivory play triangle and one red paper chat bubble fully INSIDE the black card. Scale the screen down if needed rather than stretching. Keep space between type and card; no overlap. Preserve beautiful restrained paper grain and actual cut-paper depth, no childish craft, no new elements, no figures or photos, no watermark. The major correction is the 11:7 composition with all words readable and without edge crops.
visualReview: Corrected the initial too-wide canvas to approximately 11:7, 1572×1001. All three required text phrases appear exactly once and are fully visible. Red speech bubble including its tail is entirely inside the black fullscreen card.
